title: Scattering amplitudes from quantum hardware a la RESOs
summary: We report the first quantum-hardware implementation of Real-time Estimators for Scattering Observables (RESOs). The physical model is a one-dimensional lattice theory of non-relativistic spin-1/2 fermions with a single contact interaction. The lattice sizes studied are up to $N_x=54$ lattice sites and up to $20$ time steps. Spacetime correlation functions were computed on IBM's quantum computers, using $109$ qubits with $10,806$ CZ gates applied, reaching a two-qubit gate depth of $246$.
